preliminary_textual_checkpoints.task: Check opening promise against actual delivered demonstration; narrator promises results and full creation/publication process.
Read actual Studio time windows, channel identities, monetization dates and earnings units. Narration mixes aggregate and month windows; private values are not independently verified.
Verify narrated May3→May18 dates versus14-day headline. Do not resolve auto-caption ambiguity through invention.
Observe example finished videos: shots, source provenance, narration-visual coherence, avatar use, originality and actual editing rhythm.
Inspect editor input, settings and initiation; narrative starts with a pre-existing script. Do not claim original script/title creation is taught fully.
Verify visible duration, latency and all-in cost. Distinguish claimed API minute cost from license and other costs.
Inspect discovery data, views/hour calculation, freshness and multilingual opportunity logic; absent competitor CTR/revenue remains unknown.
Identify commercial offers separately from demonstrated capability; no tool purchase or extension installation authorized by source.

application_candidates_NOT_adopted: Evidence-first original topic/angle selection before production
Separate current velocity from accumulated views and distinguish observable data from guessed audience/revenue
Map narrative sections to semantically matching original/licensed visual shots
